role: Gate: native random block ticks (randomtick_update_tick, csrc/engine/randomtick.c) against TickProbe recordings (out/java/ticks/<name>/): replays each case's scene via world_set_block, runs the tick with the case's two Randoms, and compares the write stream, 3x3 hash and World.rand state; final.bin.gz closes the run. --cases N (make smoke, probe.h): the first N cases, without final.bin.gz.

structs.name: writes
structs.java: the per-case block write stream being compared

notes: Test binary, not linked into the product; hazards listed are test-harness statics, not tick code. The block classes listed are examples of random-ticked blocks; the full scene list lives in the probe manifest and was not enumerated.
